As we can see Execution De- pendencies that spans outside of a Function Group and moreover of a single Function Group State are forbidden. The dependency from process B (inside Function Group FG_B) to process A (inside Function Group FG_A) is forbid- den, as it would introduce hidden dependencies between Function Groups that are not visible to State Management .
